notes: Bug: After swapping two panels via drag-and-drop, the crop preview canvas showed the wrong image (the unselected panel's image). Root cause: PanelSwap._onPointerUp() called onRenderScheduled() to re-render the main canvas but never triggered a crop preview re-render. MultiTouchHandler and CropInteraction both had an onCropPreviewRender callback for this purpose, but PanelSwap did not. Fix: Added onCropPreviewRender callback to createPanelSwapHandler options, called it after swap in _onPointerUp() with a guard for backward compatibility, and wired it up in createCollageLifecycle.js to call _scheduleCropPreviewRender(). Added regression test 'swap triggers onCropPreviewRender callback so crop editor updates' (34th test in PanelSwapTest, was 33). All 39 test files pass with 0 failures.
